description: This file defines the ConditionalExpression class used for handling ternary conditional expressions within Twig templates. It extends AbstractExpression and provides methods for compiling the expression into PHP code, indicating its role in expression parsing and code generation.

classes.name: ConditionalExpression
classes.description: Represents a conditional (ternary) expression node in Twig's internal AST, capable of compiling itself into PHP code, and managing operand escaping rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ConditionalExpression instance with three sub-expressions and a line number. Also triggers a deprecation warning indicating use of a deprecated class.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Converts the conditional expression into executable PHP code during compilation, handling simple Elvis operator case and standard ternary case.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns a list of operand node names that should be escaped for safe output.
